values.en: For an arc-length parametrized curve $\gamma$ with $\gamma''\neq 0$, the **Frenet frame** is the triple $\{\mathbf{t},\mathbf{n},\mathbf{b}\}$ consisting of the tangent vector, the principal normal vector and the binormal vector of $\gamma$. At every value $s$ of the arc-length parameter the three vectors are pairwise orthogonal unit vectors, so $\{\mathbf{t}(s),\mathbf{n}(s),\mathbf{b}(s)\}$ is an orthonormal basis of $\mathbb{R}^{3}$; it is right-handed, because $\mathbf{b}=\mathbf{t}\wedge\mathbf{n}$. The plane spanned by $\mathbf{t}$ and $\mathbf{n}$ is called the **osculating plane** of $\gamma$ at $\gamma(s)$; it is orthogonal to $\mathbf{b}(s)$. The Frenet frame therefore attaches a moving orthonormal basis to the curve, and the curvature and torsion measure how that frame turns.
values.zh-CN: 对满足 $\gamma''\neq 0$ 的以弧长为参数的曲线 $\gamma$，**Frenet 标架**是它的切向量、主法向量与副法向量组成的三元组 $\{\mathbf{t},\mathbf{n},\mathbf{b}\}$。在弧长参数 $s$ 的每个取值处，这三个向量两两正交且均为单位向量，故 $\{\mathbf{t}(s),\mathbf{n}(s),\mathbf{b}(s)\}$ 是 $\mathbb{R}^{3}$ 的一组正交基；又因 $\mathbf{b}=\mathbf{t}\wedge\mathbf{n}$，它是右手系的。由 $\mathbf{t}$ 与 $\mathbf{n}$ 张成的平面称为 $\gamma$ 在 $\gamma(s)$ 处的**密切平面**，它与 $\mathbf{b}(s)$ 正交。因此 Frenet 标架在曲线上给出一个活动的正交基，曲率与挠率刻画该标架的转动。
